summary: Feed s058_single to NDR is degraded: 2.7% TCP packet drops (52/1956, threshold 1%) detected; all other checks (duplicates, one-way, truncated, oversize, tunnel, VLAN, encryption, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker/TAP dropping packets under load: 2.66% of TCP packets show gaps (52/1956) indicating ingress oversubscription, microbursts exceeding the 10 Gbps tool port/buffer capacity, or fabric/SPAN congestion causing tail drops before the NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs both directions and full payload for TCP stream reassembly and detection. Missing segments break reassembly, create incomplete flows, and cause missed signatures/anomalies and reduced detection coverage (false negatives).

recommended_fix.why: Flow-aware load balancing across multiple 10G tool ports/cards eliminates single-port congestion and buffer exhaustion while preserving bidirectional flow integrity and full payload required by NDR, unlike filtering/slicing which would further reduce visibility.
